name: Himenogawa Kanaka
source:
If Kanaka could be described in 2 words then those would be “Tyrant Loli”. She’s the self-proclaimed school president and despite her small size, she can be very intimidating (even the teachers are scared of her!). Kotora is apparently her little sister. She tends not to show very much emotion until she starts watching out for Kotora.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/31/preview-diamic-days/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
